notes.title: 2 NEW SKILLS
notes.content:
Good Morning! Good Afternoon! Good Evening! Good Night!

[h3]1.61.0: 2 NEW SKILLS[/h3]
[list]
[*] DOUBLE JUMP
[*] QUICK FALL is also an ATTACK
[*] Leaderboards now work correctly
[*] Update to Unity 2022.3.32 LTS
[/list]

This DOUBLE JUMP should rather be called SECOND JUMP.
After jumping, as long as you have not touched the ground, you can perform a second jump.
It's very flexible.

[previewyoutube=J0BFXrtOmkg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]1.61.4: Fix for QUICK FALL ATTACK[/h3]
[list]
[*] Collider adjustment
[*] Attack recorded two deaths per target - Fixed
[/list]

If you like this new version of Ninja Scroller, leave a review on the store page.
This is very important for the visibility of the game.

Good game, and be real BUSHI!

[i]Olivier Raveneau
Mars Touch Studio[/i]

PS: Take a look at my next game, Underwater Diving:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2178190/Underwater_Diving/

notes.title: FINAL RELASE
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Tutorial adjustment
[*] New Ability: The acrobatic phase of the jump is now a dodge!
[/list]

The new ability was quietly introduced in the previous update.
It increases your chances of survival and offers new strategies, without making the game easy.
I consider the game final, and it goes into maintenance mode.
I can now focus all my energy on [b]Underwater Diving[/b], and producing a quality demo for June's [b]Steam Next Fest[/b].
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2178190/Underwater_Diving/

In the meantime, now is the time to test or retest the demo.
And for those who already have the game to reach higher levels.
[b]A Steam player has already completed the game, so it's possible![/b]
You will find his name in the credits of the menu.

[b]NINJUTSU[/b] (NIN = obstinacy, stamina, stealth)
[b]Obstinacy[/b] & [b]Stamina[/b], two essential qualities to finish my game and the DEMO.
Start by completing the DEMO!
If at the end you feel an irrepressible desire to see more.
Buy the game and prepare to suffer to become a Legendary Ninja.
Otherwise "Fly, you fools!"

If you like the game consider writing review.
Because those who don't like it won't forget to do it.

[b]I need you, without you I am nothing![/b]

Good game, and be real BUSHI!

[i]Olivier Raveneau
Mars Touch Studio[/i]
